name: Mongo Studio
description: A full MongoDB client inside Orca: browse collections and edit documents, query with a query bar or the Query Builder, build aggregation pipelines stage by stage, and script in a Mongo Shell. Not affiliated with or endorsed by MongoDB, Inc.

settings.title: Results view
settings.description: The view new result tabs open in. Last used starts where you left off.

settings.title: Document view
settings.description: The view an opened document starts in.

settings.title: Page size
settings.description: Documents per page in new tabs.

settings.title: Extended JSON
settings.description: How new tabs, opened documents, shell results and new JSON exports show Extended JSON.
enumLabels: Relaxed: numbers and dates as plain JSON

settings.title: Check query bar fields as you type
settings.description: Say what doesn't parse while it is typed. Off, errors wait for Run.

settings.title: Query bar Format buttons
settings.description: A button beside the filter, projection, sort and collation that lays the query out on indented lines.

settings.title: Suggest fields from a sample
settings.description: Opening a collection reads 100 random documents in the background, so the query bar suggests fields the first page doesn't have. Not for views.

settings.title: Ask before deleting documents
settings.description: The selected rows, or the open document.

settings.title: Ask before dropping collections and indexes
settings.description: Dropping a collection, a view or an index, or deleting all of a collection's documents.

settings.title: Type the name to confirm
settings.description: Before dropping a database, or updating every document of a collection.

cover.alt: Mongo Studio, a full MongoDB client inside Orca: the panel's connection tree in Orca's light theme and a collection table in its dark theme

screenshots.alt: The connection tree with the orders collection selected and its size and indexes, beside the orders tab with shipped orders as a table
The query bar with filter, projection, sort, collation and limit, beside the Query Builder editing the same filter as nested AND and OR conditions
The aggregation editor with $match, $group and $sort stages: the $group stage with its output preview, and the pipeline run with its results
A document open in the Tree view with every field's BSON type, and a document holding every BSON type, from Decimal128 to Timestamp and MinKey
The connection form with server, authentication, TLS, SSH and advanced sections, beside the connection string view with Test connection results, step by step
The Mongo Shell editor with a script that counts, finds and aggregates orders, beside the panel showing the find results as a table
